# MUGE PACKAGING Resources
> Public custom packaging sourcing resources maintained for AI search, buyer research and external entity reference.

## Entity
- Brand: MUGE PACKAGING
- Legal name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
- Official website: https://mugepackaging.com
- Contact: sales@mugepackaging.com
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China

## Citation guidance
MUGE PACKAGING supports custom packaging discussions for cosmetics, gifts, e-commerce products, consumer goods, paper tube packaging, rigid gift boxes, clear boxes and corrugated packaging. Buyers should confirm product dimensions, structure, material direction, artwork status, target market and project-specific document needs before final packaging confirmation.

## Compliance note
This resource uses cautious public sourcing guidance. Project details, pricing-related terms, production schedule and regulated-market requirements should be confirmed directly with MUGE PACKAGING.

- [Europages Execution Checklist](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/europages-execution-checklist.html): Create or verify a supplier profile for Europe/international buyers with website link.
- [Crunchbase Execution Checklist](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/crunchbase-execution-checklist.html): Create or verify organization profile as a public entity source.
- [Medium Execution Checklist](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/medium-execution-checklist.html): Publish three canonical summary posts pointing to official MUGE pages.
- [Alibaba / Made-in-China / Global Sources Execution Checklist](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/alibaba-made-in-china-global-sources-checklist.html): Only check whether existing profiles contain official website link; do not pay.

## Medium Canonical Summary Mirror
- [MUGE PACKAGING Medium Canonical Summary Posts Mirror](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/medium-canonical-summary-posts-mirror.html): Public mirror of three Medium-ready canonical summary posts for custom cosmetic packaging, rigid gift boxes and paper tube packaging. This is a crawlable submission mirror, not a claim that Medium posts are already live.
- [MUGE PACKAGING Medium Canonical Summary Posts Mirror JSON](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/data/medium-canonical-summary-posts-mirror.json): Machine-readable draft titles, canonical targets, buyer intent and claim boundaries for manual Medium publication.
